excerpt: An open-source coding agent for the IDE, CLI, and SDK. - TheWariend/CleanSlate
content_html:
CleanSlate

The open source coding agent.

Installation

The current release is CleanSlate 1.0.2. See the release notes or download it directly:

Platform Download
macOS (Apple Silicon) DMG · ZIP

Builds are signed and notarized.

Note

Intel macOS, Windows, and Linux aren't published yet. Build from source on those platforms.

In the terminal

The same agent runs without the editor:

npm install -g @cleanslate/cli
cleanslate

Or try it without installing:

npx @cleanslate/cli "fix the failing test"

Node 20 or later. It walks you through provider setup on first run, and works against any repository — the full tool set, not a reduced one.

See packages/cleanslate-cli for options, slash commands, sessions, and MCP configuration.

Building on the runtime

The engine behind both surfaces is published on its own:

npm install @cleanslate/sdk

It carries the execution loop, all 59 tools, the edit engine and a Node host, with no editor dependency. A surface supplies host capabilities — a filesystem, a way to run commands, optionally diagnostics and a browser — and the runtime drives the loop.

See packages/cleanslate-sdk.

Package Version
@cleanslate/cli 1.0.2 ·
@cleanslate/sdk 1.0.2 ·

Note

The CLI and SDK follow semantic versioning. Breaking changes require a major version release.

Building from source

Requires Node.js 22.21.1 (see .nvmrc).

cd vscode-fork
npm install
npm run watch
./scripts/code.sh

Modes

CleanSlate has two modes you can switch between per message.

  • Execution — Default, full-access mode for building things
  • Plan — Read-only mode for analysis and code exploration
    • Cannot edit files or run commands
    • Can still read, search, browse the web, and drive a browser
    • Ideal for exploring unfamiliar codebases or planning changes

Models

CleanSlate is not coupled to any provider. Bring your own key for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, xAI Grok, NVIDIA, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

Or sign in to CleanSlate Pro for managed models, higher limits, and pay-as-you-go credits. Pro is optional — everything works with your own key, and no account is required.

What the agent can do

  • Read, search, and edit across your whole codebase
  • Run commands, including long-running ones in the background
  • Drive a real browser to check its own work
  • Search and fetch from the web
  • Call any MCP server you configure

Code search runs on your machine. Indexing and embeddings use a bundled model, so your code is never sent anywhere to be searched.

Extensions

CleanSlate installs extensions from Open VSX. The Visual Studio Marketplace is Microsoft-only and can't be used by forks.

Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome — see CONTRIBUTING.md and our Code of Conduct.

To report a security issue, see SECURITY.md.

License

CleanSlate is MIT licensed.

It is a fork of Visual Studio Code (MIT, © Microsoft Corporation) — see LICENSE.txt. CleanSlate is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft.

清石

开源编码代理。

安装

当前版本是 CleanSlate 1.0.2。 查看发行说明或直接下载：

平台 下载
macOS（苹果芯片） DMG·ZIP

构建已签名并经过公证。

Note

Intel macOS、Windows 和 Linux 尚未发布。 在这些平台上从源代码构建。

在航站楼

相同的代理无需编辑器即可运行：

npm install -g @cleanslate/cli
cleanslate

或者不安装就尝试一下：

npx @cleanslate/cli "fix the failing test"

节点 20 或更高版本。 它会引导您在第一次运行时完成提供程序设置，并适用于任何存储库 - 完整的工具集，而不是简化的工具集。

请参阅packages/cleanslate-cli 了解选项、斜杠命令、会话和MCP 配置。

基于运行时构建

两个表面背后的引擎都是单独发布的：

npm install @cleanslate/sdk

它承载执行循环、所有 59 个工具、编辑引擎和 Node 主机，没有编辑器依赖性。 表面提供主机功能——文件系统、运行命令的方式、可选的诊断和浏览器——并且运行时驱动循环。

请参阅packages/cleanslate-sdk。

包裹 版本
@cleanslate/cli 1.0.2 ·
@cleanslate/sdk 1.0.2 ·

Note

CLI 和 SDK 遵循语义版本控制。 重大更改需要发布主要版本。

从源头构建

需要 Node.js 22.21.1（请参阅 .nvmrc）。

cd vscode-fork
npm install
npm run watch
./scripts/code.sh

Modes

CleanSlate 有两种模式，您可以在每条消息之间切换。

  • 执行 - 用于构建事物的默认、完全访问模式
  • 计划 — 用于分析和代码探索的只读模式 无法编辑文件或运行命令 仍然可以读取、搜索、浏览网页和驱动浏览器 非常适合探索不熟悉的代码库或计划更改

型号

CleanSlate 不与任何提供商耦合。 为 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini、Azure OpenAI、AWS Bedrock、xAI Grok、NVIDIA、OpenRouter 或任何 OpenAI 兼容端点携带自己的密钥。

或者登录 CleanSlate Pro 以获取托管模型、更高的限额和即用即付积分。 Pro 版是可选的 - 一切都可以使用您自己的密钥进行操作，并且不需要帐户。

代理可以做什么

  • 阅读、搜索和编辑整个代码库
  • 运行命令，包括在后台长时间运行的命令
  • 驱动一个真正的浏览器来检查它自己的工作
  • 从网络上搜索和获取
  • 调用您配置的任何 MCP 服务器

代码搜索在您的计算机上运行。 索引和嵌入使用捆绑模型，因此您的代码永远不会发送到任何地方进行搜索。

扩展

CleanSlate 从 Open VSX 安装扩展。 Visual Studio Marketplace 仅供 Microsoft 使用，不能被分支使用。

要报告安全问题，请参阅 SECURITY.md。
